biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit at least $10,000 within 14 days of opening and maintain it for 90 days - small-dollar referrals earn you nothing, and the bonus takes 30+ days after that to reach your Cash Account.
catches: Existing Raisin customers (Referrers) earn a $100 referral bonus for each new customer referred who opens an account with Raisin.com and makes a Qualifying Deposit of at least $10,000.
The referee must use the referrer's unique personal referral code at sign-up for the referrer to be eligible.
The qualifying deposit balance must be maintained continuously at or above $10,000 for the full 90-day maintenance period.
Referral bonuses are limited to a maximum of twenty (20) successful referrals per customer ($2,000).
Bonus payouts are credited directly to the referrer's and referee's Cash Accounts within 30 days of satisfying all requirements.
US customers only; not open to Raisin employees; Raisin may modify or end the offer at any time and may withhold or revoke bonuses in cases of fraud or abuse.

steps: Share your unique Raisin referral code with friends or family.
Friend signs up using your code and deposits at least $10,000 within 14 days of opening.
After the friend maintains the deposit for 90 days, you earn $100 per successful referral.
timing: Bonus credited to the referrer's Cash Account within 30 days of satisfying all requirements (after the 90-day maintenance period).
when_cash_arrives: Bonus credited to the referrer's Cash Account within 30 days of satisfying all requirements (after the 90-day maintenance period). Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
